# Getting help with Graphicle

- **Something not working?** Run `graphicle doctor` in your project folder. It
  checks the program, the project and every connected agent, and prints the
  command that fixes each problem it finds.
  [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/graphicle-ai/graphicle/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md)
  covers the common errors.
- **A question?** Ask in
  [Discussions, under Q&A](https://github.com/graphicle-ai/graphicle/discussions/categories/q-a).
- **A bug?** [Open an issue](https://github.com/graphicle-ai/graphicle/issues/new/choose)
  with the output of `graphicle --version` and `graphicle doctor`.
- **A security problem?** Report it privately, as
  [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/graphicle-ai/graphicle/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
  explains, never in a public issue.

The documentation starts at the
[quick start](https://github.com/graphicle-ai/graphicle/blob/main/docs/quickstart.md);
the [FAQ](https://github.com/graphicle-ai/graphicle/blob/main/docs/faq.md)
answers the common questions about models, privacy and editions.
